categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Touches the vendored `src/crc32c` subtree explicitly covered by the utils category.
categories.rationale: Updates the crc32c subtree to use inline constexpr in headers, eliminating unused variable warnings. As stated in the PR description, this is 'Used in #36275' to allow enabling the `-Wunused-const-variable` compiler warning flag across the codebase.
